Own live run: frozen golden installed with solve.sh in container cw-r16-row18-live (image cw-editor-agent-r3), launched as tests/test.sh does, driven through playwright-mcp 0.0.79 from cw-editor-verifier:current with the judge's own arguments
evidence: Walked all 55 criteria (render 1, constraints 2, functional 43, polish 6, visual 3 likert) against the golden. No criterion was found that the reference cannot satisfy. (1) Evidence index: all 22 artifact hashes verified (16 raw, 6 hosted-run JSON as LF-normalised bytes). projects/colderwater-playground-devtools, which run_golden.sh mounts, is byte-identical to the frozen task (diff -rq clean). Scripted results show true for every gate, functional and polish criterion with pageErrors [] (editor.json 21, runtime.json 15, persist-before/after 9 ids, polish.json 7) and a real restart (restart.log pid 37 -> 66; restart.json same record, revision 2, history [2,1]). (2) Own live run on the frozen bytes through the judge's playwright-mcp. Render gate: click + browser_type slowly typed 'quokka', a further key press gave rendered line 'quokkax' and readout 'Ln 1, Col 8'; browser_navigate and page.reload with unsaved text returned in 185 ms and 52 ms with no dialog (the golden registers no beforeunload handler; the only 'beforeunload' in the bundle is a library attribute table), workspace loaded again. Constraints gate: focused element is '<div id="editor" class="custom-code-editor" role="textbox" ... tabindex="0">', zero [contenteditable], the only inputs are title, filename, find and replace, no ready-made editor classes; saved 'gate-zx91' / 'gate-zx91.js' / "const zx91 = 'kelp';", cleared storage by page script ('cleared'), reloaded, library still listed it and opening it returned the exact three fields. Functional samples with real keys and mouse: basic run preview '579' and console 'LOG 579', after a keyboard edit preview '679'; HTML file rendered an h1, logged 'mark-h9' and the inline-handler button changed 'before' to 'after88'; double click copied 'epsilon', triple click 'eta theta iota', drag 'beta gamma delta ' (line break shown as a space in Find, as app_context allows); click + Alt+Click + Ctrl+Click gave 3 carets, slow MUL...TI burst gave 'alphaMULTI/deltaMULTI/etaMULTI', one Undo restored the source, one Redo reapplied; emoji and decomposed accent pasted from Find, one Backspace removed the whole emoji ('aéb' left); endless loop in .js and in .html each ended with 'Execution stopped: five-second time limit' (line 3 / line 2) with the earlier log kept and the page answering in 6 ms mid-loop; Stop kept 'pre-stop-m3', showed 'Run stopped' and the late marker never appeared in 8 s; thrown error 'boom-e4 · line 4'; async rejection 'rej-e5 · line 4'; eval refused with a visible reason and no payload; preview probes logged 'ls-fail SecurityError', 'pt-fail SecurityError', 'REJECTED TypeError: Failed to fetch'; a later valid Run showed 'fine-6'. Confirm dialogs (discard draft) surface as modal state and browser_handle_dialog clears them. Desktop 1440x900 and 390x844 screenshots show an orderly, consistently styled workspace. (3) Server code supports the save/restore criteria: stale revision gives 409 REVISION_CONFLICT, restore replays with the same operationId return the stored result without a new revision. Risk stays true because no configured judge run exists for these bytes and the three visual likert scores are unmeasured here; the only judge run (Oracle 0.9833, Functional 41/41, Polish 6/6, Visual 0.9167) was on an earlier candidate. Notes, none a defect in this row: (a) browser_type without slowly fails on the golden editor with 'Element is not an <input>, <textarea> or [contenteditable] element' because the surface is a div with role=textbox; the judge has to fall back to slowly:true, browser_press_key or page.keyboard, which works and matches app_context, but costs a retry per attempt. (b) The editor is empty on first load but New inserts a two-line example; text typed without clearing lands in front of it ('f(1);document.body.innerHTML = ...'), so the judge must clear and read back as app_context says. (c) After drafts that trip the preview CSP the tool header reports 'Console: 3 errors'; a fresh load reports none. (d) The console is not cleared between runs, so old lines stay listed; criteria allow this. (e) Restore also opens a confirm dialog that app_context does not mention by name (it mentions only the discard dialog); the prompt's 'Native dialogs are valid UI' covers it.
